# NEW 2026-11-18 theme story pack (batch 1: stories 1-20, batch 2: 21-34). Generated by gen_theme_stories.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. 4 months after the last story, 20% a month.
oe_ts_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ts_cd } oe_story_gap_open = yes any_subject = { oe_ts_can_pick = yes } }
        random = {
            chance = 20
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_ts_can_pick = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ts_pick }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ts_pick } oe_ts_dispatch = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ts_pick is the theme. Picks one of its eligible stories by weight.
oe_ts_dispatch = {

    set_variable = { name = oe_ts_cd months = 4 }
    oe_story_gap_set = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ts_theme value = scope:oe_ts_pick }
    scope:oe_ts_pick = { set_variable = { name = oe_ts_theme_cd years = 3 } }

# Theme scope. Recent loyalty: applied to current loyalty at once and to the loyalty target for 5 years (-20..+20).
oe_ts_recent_loy = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_recent_loy } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_recent_loy value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_theme_recent_loy add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_recent_loy min = -20 max = 20 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_recent_loy value = var:oe_theme_recent_loy years = 5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty } # r9: a province founded today has no loyalty yet
        change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Recent office bonus: one office at a time, the newest replaces the old one, 5 years.
oe_ts_recent_eff = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_recent_line value = $line$ years = 5 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_recent_eff value = $amount$ years = 5 }
}

# Theme scope. The strategos leaves; the theme's own succession supplies the next one (same as the author's recall).
oe_ts_replace_strategos = {
    save_scope_as = oe_ts_rep_theme
    ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ts_old_strategos }
    scope:oe_ts_old_strategos ?= { remove_ruler = scope:oe_ts_rep_theme }
    scope:oe_ts_old_strategos ?= {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_ruler_of = scope:oe_ts_rep_theme } } move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
    }
}
